detail.title: Foundational Synthesis: Self-Verification and Methodological Falsification
detail.summary: We synthesized research on error detection mechanisms and observer disagreement. By mapping DeepSeekMath-V2's approach to self-verifiable mathematical reasoning against Karl Popper's methodology of scientific research programmes, we identified that both autonomous verification and falsification frameworks serve to refine inferential models against observational data. These notebooks formalize the distinction between observational discrepancy and systematic inferential error.
